name: @genoffice/project-desktop
description: GenOffice Project desktop host (PROJECT-027) — the Electron shell that binds the shared @genoffice/project-renderer-core to the canonical engine, scheduler, and file adapters. The main process is native transport only (window/lifecycle, dialogs, filesystem, menu); every Project semantic value flows through the shared packages. NOT a foundation package (architecture-lock §3: 'Project desktop host code will be isolated under a Project-specific app surface').
